text: Trim SILG.L — it's down nearly 14% and sitting over 34% below its 52-week high in a clear downtrend, so reduce your exposure before it falls further.
Trim NCLP.L — as your worst-performing ETF, down 19% and 32% below its high while trading below its 50-day average, cut this back to limit the drag on your portfolio.
Add to ADBE — at a PE of just 8.1 with 10.5% revenue growth and outstanding free cash flow, Adobe looks genuinely undervalued and this is a good opportunity to build your position.
Add to GOOGL — with a reasonable PE of 24.6, 15% revenue growth, healthy free cash flow, and insiders buying, Google is attractively priced and worth increasing your stake.
Add to UNH — UnitedHealth is at its 52-week high with bullish momentum, insider buying, and solid fundamentals, so adding here rides the strength of a confirmed uptrend.
